content:
The provided text explains two fundamental concepts of algorithm analysis:

*   **Scalability and Input Size:** Running time is relative to the number of elements being processed (input size). To predict performance, time is expressed as a function of that size.
*   **The Importance of Upper Bounds:** Analysis focuses on "upper bounds" because they provide a maximum time guarantee to the user. Knowing a program will take *no more than* a certain amount of time is practical for real-world use, whereas knowing only a minimum time provides no useful performance limit.
